name: Coosa Backcountry Trailhead
access: Inside Vogel State Park near cabin #7. Free backcountry permit required, obtained at the visitor center.
legality: Backcountry trail; camping only at the designated Coosa/Wolf Creek backcountry campsite.
pressure: Low — permit-only backcountry trail, far less trafficked than the AT/Blood Mountain corridor nearby.
target_tips: Recommended overnight route: hike Coosa Backcountry Trail to the Wolf Creek/Coosa Creek confluence camp, pan Wolf/Coosa Creek gravel bars.
fees: $10 Vogel parking fee; free backcountry permit.
notes: Wilderness-boundary status of the Wolf Creek segment (Coosa Bald Scenic Area vs. Blood Mountain Wilderness) is UNVERIFIED — call Blue Ridge Ranger District before relying on this route for panning.
